pairs: I will confess to you with my whole heart,
for you have heard the words of my mouth.
I will sing psalms to you in the sight of the Angels.
I will adore before your holy temple,
and I will confess your name:
super misericordia tua et veritate tua;
For you have magnified your holy name above all.
On whatever day that I will call upon you:
You will multiply virtue in my soul.
Confiteantur tibi, Domine, omnes reges terræ,
May all the kings of the earth confess to you,
quia audierunt omnia verba oris tui.
O Lord. For they have heard all the words of your mouth.
And let them sing in accordance with the ways of the Lord.
For great is the glory of the Lord.
and he looks with favor on the humble.
But the lofty he knows from a distance.
If I wander into the midst of tribulation,
et super iram inimicorum meorum extendisti manum tuam,
For you extended your hand against the wrath of my enemies.
et salvum me fecit dextera tua.
And your right hand has accomplished my salvation.
The Lord will provide retribution on my behalf.
Do not disdain the works of your hands.
